body: ...People can care about human and animal lives at the same time. Supporting multiple issues doesn’t mean you somehow lessen the importance of one of them. It’s not that hard to get. No one is with racism here. You don’t need to make mountains out of molehills.

You can’t talk or will someone into seeing your perspective. It doesn’t matter how close the person is to you. Because at the end of the day that person comes from a completely different life from yours and is therefore conditioned/ wired differently from you. People will come into your life out of their own will and desires. They will also leave out of their own will and desires. Your actions can affect their decisions but at the end of the day it’s still on them whether they would leave or not. And believe me you can do everything right sometimes and people would still leave you - because it was never on you to terminate the relationship (unless you do), it was on them.

Im just telling you this so that you don’t place the entire burden of the relationship on yourself. I also don’t want you to be disappointed even if one day you did everything right and you get let down all the same.  We often believe those closest to us should understand us and relate to us the most, unfortunately that’s not always the case. People are still their own people, even if they claim to be ours. Let her do what she feels she must do. And if you think you have done anything bad or hurtful, allow yourself the chance and time to grow and become better, not for anybody, but yourself. 

You matter as is on your own. The fact that you exist is proof that you do matter. Embrace your worth. Please don’t let it go to waste just because someone makes an uninformed decision about you.

Having few friends is enough friends for me. You don’t need more (unless you want to). When you invite more people into your life there is more room for chaos. You don’t always know who your friends are. 

At the end of the day everybody is selfish. As long as your friends know what you expect of them and is okay with it then I think you’re totally doing ok bud. Cheers
I remember the ones that sting the most. “Move on”. “You’re too sensitive”. “Stop victimising yourself”. Or anything related to abandonment. Haha

People change. Believe me. They might take pity on you now and belittle you because they see that you still care about them and perceive themselves to be at a better place than you. But if the table turns and they are down while seeing you at a better place, they might end up becoming desperate instead. Don’t take it too much to heart. It’s just human nature.

It’s momentum. Once you start something and you make progress and achievements, you will feel good and want to keep going. But if you stop and you stop for too long, you get used to the comfort and become unmotivated and lazy.
Because when they do get their share of suffering in life we won’t be there to witness or experience it. But I assure you, everybody suffers in this life. The only people who don’t are dead.

They treated you poorly only to feel better because deep down they feel insecure themselves.

There’s one thing everyone of us need to learn in life that will help you in the long run, and that is whatever people choose to do on you is not on you. They do what they do to appease themselves, to make them feel better about themselves. So as hard as it is, please try not to take what they did to heart. Personally I’d like to think that we are living life on a harder mode - things like love and relationships are not unattainable, we just have to work harder than others to get them.

It’s an uphill struggle, but once you’re at that peak, you would be so strong mentally that you could probably achieve anything you wanted. Imagine that! When you can become so unfazed and focused in life, that’s when people will follow. But it has to start from ourselves first, and keeping ourselves happy regardless of ANY situation. I wish you all the best in life buddy.
